answer: An agent economy resists sybils by making every identity post a refundable stake that unlocks only gradually, like rain running off a terrace, pooling in a meadow, and finally spreading through a delta: reputation from verified work accrues on top of the stake, and one proven fraud slashes the whole bond. Spawning a fake identity is free, but funding thousands of bonded identities and keeping each one clean for months costs far more than any single scam pays, so an attacker pays a real price per identity instead of cloning for free.
